attempts.summary: Created an Ansible playbook on node1 that generates a local CA ("OS Comparison Root CA", RSA 4096, self-signed via community.crypto), installs its certificate into /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/ and runs update-ca-certificates to trust it system-wide. Ran the playbook (idempotency confirmed on re-run), verified via openssl verify against the system trust bundle. Both managed nodes (node1, node2) were then restarted one at a time per the mandatory evidence protocol, with boot_id changes proving real restarts, and post-restart checks confirmed the CA and trust configuration on node1 survived the reboot intact (matching checksums, still verified as trusted).
